entries.technical: Source-specific credibility is held by the recipient. A processed episode changes it at .04*reliability toward the interpreted performance. The relevant credibility enters later supporter weighting. Ordinary accessed stories, teaching episodes, coalition work and known governance episodes call this pathway; no global charisma or champion bonus exists.

entries.technical: The current proxy reports actors in eligible recorded acts whose case reached investigation or decision within a trailing-year cohort. Counts are stratified by three ranks and connected/other groups. Below 20 observations the UI flags insufficient evidence. This is a synthetic process proxy; it does not establish matched-case impartiality or legal guilt.

entries.technical: Poisson count sampling uses role intensities [.65,.85,.20,.20]. Every completed contact requires .015 PM from both participants. Pending service retries can be abandoned after six months through utility choice. Campaign and business-political opportunities remain. Explicit request IDs and episode keys distinguish repeated contacts.

entries.technical: Primary-role compensation debits the actual employer account. The legacy 180*g treasury grant and wage withholding are removed. Investment, reserve retention, eligible distribution and attempted diversion are distinct leader choices. Ownership is explicitly initialized to the organizational leader as a provisional prior; ordinary membership creates no dividend right. Diverted entrusted funds face internal review.

entries.title: Business productive-capacity stock
entries.status: implemented in provisional v3.0; calibration and stated simplifications remain
entries.narrative: Productive capacity belongs to business organizations and differs from organizational capability. Equipment payment, delivery, installation work and usable capacity are separately recorded.
entries.technical: Capital consumes .08/year converted to a monthly fraction. Funded equipment projects wait one to three months, then require .05+.02*paid RU of performed installation PM. A completed project adds paidRU/(12*3) outputRU/month once. Missing work prevents completion even after the delivery date. Depreciation is a capacity flow rather than a second cash payment.

entries.title: Demand-constrained production and allocation
entries.status: implemented in provisional v3.0; calibration and stated simplifications remain
entries.narrative: Demand, capacity, inputs, work and payment constrain realized production. Private demand and public procurement may distribute opportunities unevenly; rearranging orders alone does not create national output.
entries.technical: Household purchases split .35 explicit/.65 background. Background purchasing responds to recent receipts and a reserve requirement; foreign reference demand is 60 RU/month. Production is bounded by available capacity, actual funds and private organizational time at 15 outputRU/PM. Imported intermediate inputs cost .20 of delivered output. Unfilled orders expire after six months; the current order list uses deterministic insertion order.
entries.limitations: Uncalibrated common engineering parameters; compact generic procedures and recorded proxies are not a complete national system. See the v3 extension status and deferred calibration plan.

entries.title: Taxable activity, compliance and public receipts
entries.status: implemented in provisional v3.0; calibration and stated simplifications remain
entries.narrative: Potential liability, declared or discovered assessment, compliance, arrears and actual collection remain separate. The simplified mechanism taxes private business value added; additional receipts expand fiscal choices without automatically funding reform.
entries.technical: Assessment uses .22 of taxable business VA as an uncalibrated rate. Concealment and a requested concession have distinct choices; a concession requires an actual connected collector and their approval. Unpaid assessment persists. Actual collection is cash-limited and capped at .25 of business cash per round. Background private VA uses .85 aggregate compliance. Fines and identified domestic receipts remain transfers, not additional production.
entries.limitations: Uncalibrated common engineering parameters; compact generic procedures and recorded proxies are not a complete national system. See the v3 extension status and deferred calibration plan.

entries.title: Economic boundaries and output index
entries.status: implemented in provisional v3.0; calibration and stated simplifications remain
entries.narrative: Explicit domestic actors trade with a separate background domestic component and foreign account, preserving the existing 1,000-person structure. The real-activity index starts at 100 and follows delivered domestic value added.
entries.technical: VA is explicit business output less imported consumed intermediates, plus background domestic production and performed public nonmarket output. Public output uses actual paid compensation times the performed-work share. The reference is the last reconstructed month’s VA and starts at 100. All prices are fixed normalized RU; no validated GDP-per-capita conversion is supplied. Initial boundary cash is a synthetic finite reserve, split 80% domestic/20% foreign.
